goal: Find the root cause of an overfull-stack bug and fix it without changing the contract
prompt:
In my Roblox game: players report that picking up 70 potions with a stack limit of 20 gives one stack of 70 instead of 20, 20, 20, 10. Debug this function, fix the root cause, keep the signature, and keep mutating and returning the same `stacks` table. In one sentence, say what the root cause was.

local function addItem(stacks, name, amount, maxStack)
	for i = 1, #stacks do
		local s = stacks[i]
		if s.name == name and s.count < maxStack then
			local room = maxStack - s.count
			local put = math.min(room, amount)
			s.count += put
			amount -= put
		end
	end
	while amount > 0 do
		local put = math.min(maxStack, amount)
		table.insert(stacks, { name = name, count = amount })
		amount -= put
	end
	return stacks
end
return addItem
